recognize_zh: 新生兒周邊血抹片中紅血球明顯大小不等，有大型多染性紅血球、兩個有核紅血球、表面帶規則小刺的棘狀紅血球（prickle cell／echinocyte）、口形與不規則中央淡染的紅血球，但缺乏大量球形紅血球；非球形溶血性貧血伴棘狀細胞，配合 PKLR 突變，符合丙酮酸激酶缺乏症。
features: Marked anisocytosis with numerous large polychromatophilic red cells (reticulocytes)
Two nucleated red blood cells (orthochromatic/polychromatic normoblasts)
Occasional echinocytic 'prickle cells' with short, regular surface spicules
Red cells with slit-like, triangular or irregular central pallor (stomatocyte/knizocyte-like forms) and occasional target-like cells
Scattered contracted/irregular poikilocytes; spherocytes are not prominent
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows marked anisocytosis with prominent polychromasia and large reticulocytes. Two nucleated red blood cells are present. Poikilocytes include echinocytic prickle cells with short regular spicules, cells with slit-like or irregular central pallor, occasional target-like forms and scattered contracted irregular cells. Spherocytes, schistocytes and bite cells are not conspicuous. Platelets are adequate with small clumps. In a neonate with hemolytic anemia, reticulocytosis and a PKLR mutation, the findings are consistent with congenital non-spherocytic hemolytic anemia due to pyruvate kinase deficiency.

ddx.vs: HS shows numerous small dense spherocytes lacking central pallor with increased osmotic fragility and reduced EMA binding, rather than prickle cells and stomatocyte-like forms.
G6PD deficiency shows bite and blister cells with Heinz bodies during oxidant hemolysis and low G6PD activity, whereas prickle cells and a normal G6PD level favor PK deficiency.
Alloimmune hemolysis shows spherocytes with a positive direct antiglobulin test, whereas PK deficiency is DAT-negative with non-spherocytic morphology.

Storage or drying artifact produces crenated cells uniformly across the slide, whereas PK deficiency shows scattered prickle cells alongside polychromasia and nucleated red cells, especially post-splenectomy.
